_comment: Canonical BLE dial-backoff schedule, shared by bearers/apple/HopBearerBle (bleNextBackoffS)
and bearers/android/bearer-ble (nextBackoffMs). Jitter is EXCLUDED: it is caller-supplied and
deliberately random, so only the deterministic base is pinned.
These two implementations DIVERGED once: Android moved to count-based growth after finding a
delta-based schedule reset to the floor every cycle (a dial takes DIAL_TIMEOUT_MS=12s to fail,
which outlasts a sub-2s window, so a peer that never yields an L2CAP channel re-dialed every
~13s forever and starved healthy peers). Apple kept the broken version until this file existed.
tools/ble-backoff-parity.sh fails CI if either implementation stops matching these numbers.
